create_rand_augment_transform: create a RandAugment transform with configurable magnitude, num_layers, and increasing severity
create_auto_augment_transform: create an AutoAugment transform using a learned policy such as v0, v0r, original, or originalr
build_augment_op: build an AugmentOp instance that applies a named image augmentation with probability and magnitude
get_auto_augment_policy: get an auto augment policy list from v0, v0r, original, or originalr with configurable magnitude noise
run_rand_augment_ops: run rand augment ops to generate a list of AugmentOp instances from a set of image transforms
